title: docs(changeset): correct the AIInsights paragraph in the 8178 entry (objectui#9625)
body:
Fixes #9625

Clause-②: no

A prose-only correction to **one paragraph** of a pending release declaration,
`.changeset/8178-ai-schemas-retire-zero-read-members.md`. No package code, no
schema, no exported name. One file, 13 insertions / 4 deletions.

## The defect

That entry's closing paragraph made three claims about `AIInsightsSchema.objectName`.
objectui#8800 — landed as objectui#9622, squash `1bd1be7e2660` — falsified all three,
and **both declarations are still pending, in the same release**. So the false
sentence and the change that falsifies it would publish into the CHANGELOG
together, where the sentence becomes a permanent record of a pin that never
shipped. The window ends the moment release PR objectui#5400 merges; that PR is
open as of this writing.

## Each claim re-measured on this branch's base, `29a8a95261ce`

| claim in the paragraph | reading on the base | instrument |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "is deliberately untouched" | **false** — the schema is gone | `AIInsightsSchema` reads **0** in comment-stripped `packages/types/src/index.ts`; **lit control** `AIRecommendationsSchema`, same file, same query, reads **1**. The tombstone comment standing where the interface was is in `packages/types/src/ai.ts` |
| "A pin holds it at string-or-undefined" | **false** — the pin is gone | the docblock that replaced it in `packages/types/src/__tests__/ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` says so in those words: the exclusion was "REWRITTEN BY RULING" |
| "was neither screened nor decided" | **false** — it was both | objectui#8800's own pending entry records director decision batch #137 item 2, 2026-09-15, letter A |

⚠️ The unreleased check is **structural, not a CHANGELOG grep**:
`git cat-file -e origin/main:.changeset/8178-…md` exits 0 ⇒ the file is present,
and `changeset version` *consumes* a declaration, so a present file is an
unconsumed one. A negative control (a name that is not in the tree) exits 128 in
the same query. A CHANGELOG grep for a card number is a dark instrument on this
board and was deliberately not used.

## What was kept, and why

The paragraph had a half that is **still true**: objectui#8178's ruling named three
schemas, and this entry retires seven members on those three and touches no
fourth. That half is kept and named explicitly as the load-bearing one, so a
reader can tell which part was the real claim and which part was the spent
reason. The replacement is past tense for what was true when the entry was
written, plus a forward pointer to what changed and where to read it.

Shape follows the precedent already on `main`: `c9f9baedf` (PR objectui#9495)
corrected three falsified sentences in a pre-existing pending changeset in place,
prose only, frontmatter byte-identical.

## Scope, asserted

- **Frontmatter byte-identical** — `sha256` of the file's first five lines
  compared against the base blob: `5285f233de7cd6fd83f1d0520a688081e9928771bee8df89cdea64e19e112f38`, equal before and after.
- Level unchanged (`minor`), package list unchanged (`@object-ui/types`,
  `@object-ui/plugin-ai`).
- ⛔ No other paragraph in the file is edited, ⛔ no other changeset is touched,
  and ⛔ no new changeset is added — this edits a pending entry and ships no
  package code, which `check-changeset-presence` confirms ("no changeset is
  owed").

⚠️ A `.changeset` body publishes verbatim into a CHANGELOG that renders on
GitHub, where tag-shaped fragments are deleted — including inside backticks. The
replacement prose was scanned for them and contains none; the type it names is
written as the words string-or-undefined rather than with a bar between two bare
type names in brackets. The sibling entry `.changeset/8655-…md` uses the spaced
form for the same reason.

## Gates — re-derived by hand against the actual changed file

⚠️ `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` lives in the sibling repository and refuses
objectui paths by design, so this list comes from objectui's own `package.json`
and `.github/workflows/changeset-guard.yml` / `changeset-presence.yml`. Exit
codes were captured to disk before any pipe.

| gate | exit | reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pnpm changeset:check` | 0 | fixed group OK; no `major` declared |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | 1 file changed, 0 published source, "no changeset is owed" |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | 0 | reports this edit as its legitimate **case 2** (correcting a declaration on purpose). "declared at base" and "declares now" are identical, so no declaration was lost. That report is the expected shape, ⛔ not a failure |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | 0 files changed outside `.changeset/` ⇒ no pending body names a file this change touches. ⚠️ Vacuous by construction for a changeset-only diff, and reported as such rather than as coverage |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | no test source names a pending changeset |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | 7801 tracked text files scanned |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | 0 new cross-file line-address citations added |

No vitest run: no package source, test or manifest changed, so no suite is owed.

**Declared deviation:** `pnpm install` was not run in this worktree. Every gate
above is a plain Node script or a `pnpm run` of one, and all seven ran green
without `node_modules`. Nothing in this diff can be built or tested, so the
install would have bought no reading on a shared container.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 只改一段话。待发布的 changeset `8178-ai-schemas-retire-zero-read-members.md`
最后一段声称 `AIInsightsSchema.objectName` "刻意未动"、"有一个 pin 钉着它"、"那第四个 schema
既没筛也没裁"。这三句今天全是假的。本 PR 把这一段改写成:哪一半仍然成立(本条目的范围是三个
schema 上的七个成员),哪一半已经作废,以及作废它的是哪条裁决、读者该去哪里看。frontmatter、
发版级别、包清单、以及文件里其它任何一段,一律未动。

**为什么改** —— changeset 正文是**逐字**发布进 CHANGELOG 的。推翻这三句话的那次改动
(objectui#8800,以 objectui#9622 落地)和这段假话**在同一次发布里**。release PR objectui#5400
一合并,这段话就永久冻进已发布的 CHANGELOG,变成一条"某个 pin 存在过"的错误记录——而那个 pin
从未发运。窗口现在开着,这是这张卡此刻被做的唯一理由。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险接近于零:不含任何包代码、schema 或导出名,发版级别与包清单
逐字节未动,frontmatter 的 sha256 与基点一致。回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit,发布内容不受影响。
唯一需要维护者过目的是**措辞**:替换后的段落对 objectui#8800 的转述是否准确、是否越出了
objectui#8800 裁决的授权范围(本席的判断:没有——那条裁决管的是 pin,本 PR 改的是 prose)。

**席位意见** ——

**你要做的** —— 只需确认两件事:① 替换段落的事实转述无误;② 它赶在 release PR objectui#5400
合并之前落地。此外无需任何操作。

## Acceptance notes

Two things were checked in the same file and ⛔ deliberately **not** changed, per
the card's ask (one paragraph only) — both are reported for the seat rather than
fixed here:

- The "Nothing behavioural changes" census paragraph, the "Why not Enforce"
  paragraph and the "Why tombstones and not deletions" paragraph were each
  re-read against today's tree and are **still true**: the seven `?: never`
  tombstones are present in `packages/types/src/ai.ts`, all three schemas still
  extend `BaseSchema`, and `BaseSchema` still carries its string-index
  signature.
- "a fifty-item render pins it in both layouts" — the pin
  (`AIRecommendations.rendersEveryItem-8178.test.tsx`) does use fifty items and
  does cover two layouts, and the component has exactly two render branches, so
  the sentence matches the code. ⚠️ Worth a seat's eye only because the declared
  union has **three** spellings (`list` / `grid` / `carousel`) while "both" names
  two — a reader could take "both" as "all there are". Not false, so ⛔ not
  filed.
